title: SurvivalPlus⚔️
description: SurvivalPlus adds Blood Moons, Titan Zombies, VeinMiner, Graves, and more to enhance your vanilla experience!
body:
Title: SurvivalPlus ⚔️ | Blood Moon, Titans, VeinMiner & More!

Description: SurvivalPlus enhances your vanilla survival experience by adding unique challenges and essential Quality of Life (QoL) features. It's designed to make the game harder at night but smoother during the day!

**🔥 Key Features:**

**🩸 The Blood Moon System:**

Every night has a chance to turn into a Blood Moon!

Zombies and Skeletons spawn with Red Armor, Speed, and Strength buffs.

Warning: They inflict Blindness on hit!

No Sleep: You cannot sleep during a Blood Moon. survive or die!

**🧟 Titan Zombie:**

A rare, powerful boss zombie spawning naturally.

Equipped with full Diamond/Gold armor.

Drops high-tier loot when defeated.

**⛏️ Vein Miner:**

Break entire ore veins or chop down whole trees in one hit!

Works smoothly with Pickaxes and Axes.

**🪝 Grappling Hook:**

Use a Fishing Rod to swing across ravines or pull yourself to high places.

**⚰️ Grave System:**

Never lose your items again! Upon death, your inventory is safely stored in a chest.

**🧲 Magnet Stone:**

Craft a Nether Star (Magnet) to pull nearby items to you by sneaking.

**🍂 Fast Leaf Decay:**

Leaves disappear quickly after cutting down a tree.

**⚙️ Configuration:** You can fully customize chances, names, and toggle features via the config.yml.

# /survivalplus reload - Reloads the configuration instantly.
